requirement.text: A secondary-school qualification that gives access to university in your home country (or Polish Matura); foreign candidates are ranked separately and usually selected by an interview, held in English for English-taught programmes. English at B2 or higher (IELTS Academic 5.5, TOEFL iBT 72, Cambridge B2 First) is shown at registration unless verified at the interview. Application fee is non-refundable.
